query:
DELETE FROM refresh_tokens WHERE id IN (
                        SELECT id FROM (
                            SELECT
                                id,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY created_at DESC) token_number
                            FROM refresh_tokens
                            WHERE user_id = $1 AND replaced_at IS NULL
                        ) live_refresh_tokens
                        WHERE token_number > $2
                ) OR (user_id = $1 AND expires_at < NOW())
